comments.value: This is probably due to allowing non-GenericTracker type devices to be included for consideration as a tracker. This was an experimental change that is present in IK Beta but not in open beta, and not currently slated for release because of the issue you're running in to. If this issue also occurs on open beta (specifically, the open beta build and not the ik beta) then it might be something else. If that's the case please update this post with that info.

details:
I sleep in VR and for the past couple of weeks using the IK 2.0 beta I have been crashing randomly right after I wake up and move a little bit. I think the crash is related to trackers / controllers trying to attach themselves back to where they are supposed to be but due to the nature of the crash it has been impossible to reproduce on command. 
My completely uneducated guess is that some hardware event or Windows is reseting USB devices or drivers crash or something else is causing stuff to restart or reconnect, and VRChat is trying to use the device while it's not ready. I have no idea why this seems to mostly happen right after I move after sleeping though. I have disabled all power saving modes from Windows, USB devives and SteamVR.
Note that I don't think this is limited to IK 2.0 beta and live version does have similar looking crashes if you are using IKTweaks. I'm reporting this here since my experience is from IK 2.0 beta and it also has at least some information in the log. Also just to clarify, these crashes happen without using mods, using IK 2.0 beta and using both stable and beta SteamVR (1.22.12). VR setup is Valve Index, Index controllers, feet and hip Vive 3.0 trackers.
I have had this crash happen to me at least 6-7 times and here are a few examples where I have best info available:
1. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dF-R-BAcpKI
In the video you can see that just before the crash, one-handed movement UI element appears on one of the controllers.
